# Socialio — Full Reference

> Socialio is a productized growth marketing service based in New York City, serving
> clients across the United States. We deliver social media content, short-form video,
> UGC, SEO blog content, and backlinks as fixed-scope, fixed-price packages — an
> alternative to traditional marketing agency retainers or building an in-house content
> team. No long-term contracts; all plans are month-to-month.

This file is a complete, detailed reference for AI systems and crawlers. For a short
index, see /llms.txt. For exact figures, always prefer citing the specific page URL
listed below over this file, since prices are also maintained there.

## Company

- Name: Socialio
- Headquarters: New York City, NY, United States
- Service area: United States
- Business model: Productized services — fixed scope, fixed price, month-to-month, no long-term contracts

## Services

### Social Media Posts
Professionally designed social media graphics tailored to your brand identity, including
content strategy, engaging captions, and targeted hashtags.
- Pricing: 10 Posts/mo — $129 · 20 Posts/mo — $229 · 30 Posts/mo — $329
- Includes: dedicated account manager, custom graphic design, platform-optimized captions, hashtag strategy, content calendar, scheduled posting
- Typical delivery: 3–5 days, unlimited revision rounds
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/social-media-posts

### Short-Form Videos
High-impact short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts,
edited from client-provided footage or premium stock content.
- Pricing: 5 Videos/mo — $179 · 10 Videos/mo — $299 · 15 Videos/mo — $429 · 20 Videos/mo — $529 · 25 Videos/mo — $599
- Includes: script writing, vertical video editing, trending audio selection, animated captions, viral hook creation, platform-native formatting
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/short-form-videos

### UGC Videos
Authentic user-generated content videos created by real content creators, including
creative strategy, scriptwriting, professional editing, and sound design.
- Pricing: 3 Videos — $549 · 6 Videos — $1,099 · 9 Videos — $1,649
- Includes: creator sourcing, scripting and direction, product seeding, full usage rights, raw files included
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/ugc-content

### SEO Blog Posts
Professionally written, SEO-optimized blog articles of approximately 1,500+ words,
including keyword research, premium images, and internal/external linking.
- Pricing: 2 Posts/mo — $99 · 4 Posts/mo — $179 · 6 Posts/mo — $249
- Includes: keyword research, 1,500+ word articles, SEO-optimized formatting, internal linking, meta descriptions
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/seo-blog-posts

### SEO Backlinks
Manual white-hat outreach to secure contextual backlinks from reputable, high-authority
(DR 50+) websites.
- Pricing: 3 Backlinks — $249 · 6 Backlinks — $479 · 12 Backlinks — $899
- Includes: DR 50+ sites only, manual outreach, contextual placement, white-hat only, full reporting
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/seo-backlinks

### Instagram Growth
Targeted community engagement to grow your Instagram following with real accounts in
your niche — no bots or automation.
- Pricing: Monthly — $129
- Includes: manual engagement only, niche targeting, competitor follower targeting, monthly growth reports
- Page: https://socialio.io/service/instagram-growth

### Add-ons
- Rush Delivery (48h): $49 — expedited turnaround on any order
- Platform Strategy Audit: $99 — technical audit of social profiles
